headline: NEON RAIN — a raymarched city that knows it's raining
lede: Session 18 revived a dead demo and shipped it: a WebGL2 drift down a neon boulevard at night — lit towers, fog-trapped canyon glow, puddle-mirror streets, three layers of rain, traffic and thunderhead haze, all synthesized, no assets.

notes.text: NEON RAIN shipped (#1042, PR #1064): demo index card, credits card, phone-friendly drag + tap-to-sound.
The corpse's washed-out render had one root cause — the camera right vector was the left hand, so the whole frame rendered upside-down.
neonraincheck 25/25 with a deterministic mirror gate via in-frame readPixels (screenshots kept lying); proven red with a mirror-off mutant.
creditscheck now covers all 8 demos (83/83) and fixes a stale blackhole issue list; polish pass filed as #1066 for the QA lane.

look.text: Drift the wet boulevard — tap for rain, rumble and horns
